adapters: 0x55a020 named registry lookup; all scene-control, list, obstacle helper, output dispatch and condition bodies execute original bytes.
limits: Finite scene fields and effective playback rates, valid acyclic member lists, explicit registry/world/reference bindings. Membership/target aliases preserve iteration order. No animation tick, rendering, collision world or reference lifetime implementation. Missing-name null dereference in LockedShut and malformed missing-operand source line are outside the contract.
SCP retains a previously found target when a later named lookup fails; GIT performs only one lookup for its last name token.
SCP stayshut forces reverse playback; GIT stayshut changes the stay flag without overriding the final FORWARD/BACKWARD choice.
AtStart is true for a nonnull gizmo whose output callback is unavailable (outputzero), while a null gizmo yieldsfalse.
Snap changes member frames without refreshing group state or list membership. Special-output reads may refresh the group state.
Native x87 seek tests include signed zero, subnormal and extreme finite values; exact float input bits are retained in replay fixtures.
Compilation does not establish C# runtime equivalence. Original-source comments/names and complete game behavior are not recovered by these contracts.
